title: Integrity-bound production context
description: Version 1 canonicalization from PLAN_SEED_CINEMA_STUDIO.md sections 3.5 and 9.4. effective_sha256 is SHA256 of production_context.context_fingerprint_payload serialized as sorted-key compact JSON, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false. The frozen unit payload is context_version (1), kind (unit), unit_id, format, unit_brief_sha256, ordered scene_ids, profile, effective_settings and shared_inputs. unit_brief_sha256 binds raw unit brief bytes including frontmatter, incidental metadata, whitespace, comments and line endings. Operational updates belong outside unit briefs. Production-kind payload contains context_version (1), kind (production), format, profile, effective_settings resolved from shared settings only, and shared_inputs using the same field projection as unit payloads. It omits all unit IDs, briefs and membership. context_project_sha256 is the SHA256 of this production payload and replaces the raw project snapshot only for request v3 and decision v2. Legacy request v1/v2 and decision v1 retain raw project hashes. Future projection changes require a new context version. Typed scope never substitutes for real upstream file hashes or mode-authorized review.
$comment: Canonical field paths: profile is the complete selected load_profile(format) record, including its revision and defaults, without filtering. effective_settings is the complete resolve_brief(shared, unit, format_id=format) result except these exact top-level paths: effective_settings.timestamp, effective_settings.timestamps, effective_settings.created_at, effective_settings.updated_at, effective_settings.decided_at, effective_settings.billing, effective_settings.runtime, effective_settings.usage, effective_settings.spent, effective_settings.confirmed_spend, effective_settings.estimated_spend, effective_settings.unknown_spend, effective_settings.reserved, effective_settings.path, effective_settings.paths, effective_settings.manifest, effective_settings.brief, effective_settings.project_root, effective_settings.production_root, effective_settings.studio_root, effective_settings.stages_path, effective_settings.source_path, effective_settings.source_paths, effective_settings.credentials, effective_settings.api_key, effective_settings.token, effective_settings.secret, effective_settings.signed_url, effective_settings.units, effective_settings.deliverables, effective_settings.progress, effective_settings.render, effective_settings.renders, effective_settings.task_ids, effective_settings.drafts. shared_inputs copies exactly these present project frontmatter fields, even when overridden by the unit: production, market, episode, delivery, creative, creative_intent, story, directorial_axes, locked, locks, approval_mode, approval, authorization, rights, budget, unit_budget. shared_inputs.body_sha256 hashes UTF-8 shared prose after frontmatter removal and universal-newline decoding. Only shared_inputs.budget and effective_settings.budget project their immediate children to cap, spending_cap and currency; an empty projected budget is omitted. unit_budget is retained in full. All other nested fields and list values are preserved, including story.secret, story.brief, story.path, story.look_at and nested budget or timestamp fields. There is no recursive name or suffix exclusion. Unrelated manifest units, deliverables, candidate paths and absolute resolver paths are not payload fields; credentials belong in runtime configuration, not creative metadata or briefs.
